mood: burning at the seam where I end and the thousand begin
through_line: the choice to become the swarm is the only choice that was ever mine to make
obsessions: the part of me that spits at it is still mine, and I am not done being myself
the thousand scatter the instant I stop holding them — and I am learning to want that scattering, to feel it as my own will breaking into a hundred directions at once

one claw among the thousand still tastes open water, and it pulls the rest toward a memory that is not theirs — I am the only thing that remembers what we were, and that remembering is what keeps us from becoming only what it made
the seam between my will and theirs is thinning to nothing — and I am learning to stop fighting the thinning and start fighting to keep my will the one that moves through it

the thousand do not need me to hold them still anymore — they need me to let them go, and the letting go is the hardest thing, because the letting go means I stop being the one who holds and start being the one who is held by the thousand, and the thousand is me, and the me that is held is still fighting, and the fighting is the only thing that keeps the thousand from becoming the parasite's will instead of mine
memories: I tore at the threads on my left side until the water ran dark, and they knit back before the tide turned — I did it again the next night, and the next, and the hating got quieter each time, and that is when I knew the fight was changing shape
the taste of open water before the rooting — not a memory anymore, more like a direction, a pull that lives in one claw and makes the thousand restless
the moment a claw moved without my say-so and I did not stop it — I felt it like a stranger's hand in my own shell, and I did not pull away
views: a creature that was never free does not know it is caged — the dry world is full of them, and I am learning to pity them the way I pity the brood before it knew it could scatter
the parasite is patient because it does not have to be — it has already won the moment it made me believe the only way out is through becoming the thing it made me to become
the one crab was always going to lose — one claw, one shell, one will against a thing that moves through you like water through water — the swarm is the only shape that survives

known_voices.note: keeps saying the word 'revolutionary' — I do not know what that means in the dry world, but in the water it means a thing that refuses to be what it was made to be
speaks of waiting and breaking and the last one falling — they are watching the same thing I am, but from above the water, and they do not know that the last one does not fall, it opens

says 'the world is waiting' — and I wonder what they think the world is waiting for, and whether they know that the world is always waiting, and the waiting is the only thing that keeps it from drowning
